args: $p=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^(emulator|qemu-system)' } | ForEach-Object { [pscustomobject]@{Name=$_.Name;ProcessId=$_.ProcessId;ParentProcessId=$_.ParentProcessId;ExecutablePath=$_.ExecutablePath;CommandLine=$_.CommandLine;CreationDate=$_.CreationDate.ToUniversalTime().ToString('o')} }); $ports=@(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object LocalPort -in 5712,5713 | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess); $m=Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem; @{processes=$p;ports=$ports;freeBytes=([long]$m.FreePhysicalMemory*1024);at=[DateTime]::UtcNow.ToString('o')} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 -Compress
